(defrule
	(up-timer-status t-transport-escort == timer-triggered)
	(goal gl-transport-escort-state ESCORT-IDLE)
	;Do not reattach guards while any independent mission is unloading.
	(not (goal gl-am1-state 2))
	(not (goal gl-am2-state 2))
	(not (goal gl-am3-state 2))
	;The active route owns final-approach spacing. Reattaching a guard during the
	;landing window can pin the loaded hull against its own escort until the
	;fixed landing timer recalls it.
	(not (goal gl-transport-route-state TRANSPORT-ROUTE-RETURN-WAIT))
	(unit-type-count transport-ship >= 1)
	(or
		(warboat-count >= 1)
		(unit-type-count boarding-ship >= 1)
	)
=>
	(up-modify-goal gl-transport-escort-focus-player s:= sn-focus-player-number)
	;Release any prior escorts first. Clearing the group flag does not cancel an
	;existing guard order, so a failed or emptied transport otherwise keeps its
	;warships stranded beside it.
	(set-strategic-number sn-focus-player-number my-player-number)
	(up-set-group search-local c: transport-escort-group)
	;OWNERSHIP command: transport-escort-group.
	(up-remove-objects search-local object-data-player != my-player-number)
	(up-remove-objects search-local object-data-group-flag != transport-escort-group)
	; RAW12 counter 3
	(up-modify-goal gl-command-counter-3 c:+ 1)
	(up-target-point position-self-x action-stop -1 stance-no-attack)
	(up-modify-group-flag 0 c: transport-escort-group)
	(up-reset-group c: transport-escort-group)
	(up-full-reset-search)
	(set-strategic-number sn-focus-player-number my-player-number)
	(up-find-remote c: transport-ship c: 40)
	(up-remove-objects search-remote object-data-id g:== gl-quarantine-transport-id)
	(up-remove-objects search-remote object-data-garrison-count <= 0)
	;A loaded hull waiting motionless at a Port has no voyage to escort.  Guarding
	;it boxes the berth and reserves otherwise useful opportunity ships.
	(up-remove-objects search-remote object-data-idling == 1)
	(up-clean-search search-remote object-data-distance search-order-asc)
	(up-get-search-state local-total)
	(set-goal gl-transport-escort-state ESCORT-FIND)
)

sites.original:
(defrule
	(goal gl-wonder-state WONDER-STATE-SAVING)
	(victory-condition standard)
	(current-age == imperial-age)
	(goal gl-owner-worker-hold NO)
	(up-compare-goal gl-game-time g:>= gl-wonder-election-time)
	(up-compare-goal gl-game-time g:>= gl-wonder-build-next)
	(goal gl-home-defense-state NO)
	(building-type-count town-center >= 1)
	(up-object-type-count-total c: villager-class >= 60)
	(building-type-count-total wonder <= 0)
	(up-pending-objects c: wonder <= 0)
	(not (up-pending-placement c: wonder))
	(players-building-type-count any-ally wonder <= 0)
	(wood-amount >= 1400)
	(gold-amount >= 1500)
	(stone-amount >= 1400)
	(up-can-build 0 c: wonder)
=>
	;Normal placement keeps the foundation in the established defended town, and
	;the existing Wonder assignment/placement-pressure owners supply 15 builders.
	(up-build place-normal 0 c: wonder)
	(up-modify-goal gl-wonder-build-attempts c:+ 1)
	(up-modify-goal gl-wonder-build-next g:= gl-game-time)
	(up-modify-goal gl-wonder-build-next c:+ 180)
	(up-chat-data-to-self "stalemate Wonder requested player: %d" g: gl-self-player-number)
	(chat-to-allies "Long stalemate detected; I am building a Wonder")
	(set-goal gl-wonder-state WONDER-STATE-BUILDING)
)
